description: This file provides utility functions for splitting a string into a linked list of tokens, primarily splitting on spaces and filtering out empty tokens.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits the input string into tokens separated by spaces, returning a linked list of valid tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it passes validation (i.e., not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks whether a given token is valid (non-empty).
